# Lorem Technology

Official website: https://justlorem.com/

Lorem Technology is an AI-first development studio based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The company builds agentic workflows, product interfaces, AI UX prototypes, and launch-ready software with human-reviewed engineering quality gates.

Legal entity:
- Vietnamese legal name: CÔNG TY TNHH CÔNG NGHỆ LOREM
- International name: LOREM TECHNOLOGY COMPANY LIMITED
- Tax ID: 0315880407
- Public tax reference: https://masothue.com/0315880407-cong-ty-tnhh-cong-nghe-lorem
- Phone: 0931138999
- Email: taind2512@gmail.com

Primary services:
- AI Product Engineering
- AI UX & Prototype Systems
- Agentic Workflow Automation
- Product Architecture

Selected work:
- HyperLaunch: UX/UI design for a launch-focused Web3 product experience.
- Bumpies: game-facing web experience and responsive product presentation.
- Card Masters: website design and development for a card-game product.
- Ton Farm: product website and responsive web presence.
- Sugar Senpai: stylized game website and product presentation.
- XayKenhTikTok: solution architecture and workflow-oriented product surface.

AI-first delivery model:
- Prompt intake: clarify goals, constraints, risks, and launch path.
- Agent plan: break product work into reviewed tasks and interfaces.
- UI build: generate, refine, and implement product surfaces.
- Tests: run lint, typecheck, audit, build, and browser checks.
- PR/deploy: ship through reviewable commits and deployment gates.
